message:
docs(field): 15:14 run wording -- avgLatencyUs is a relative timeline lag, NACK effect unproven (not zero loss), UAC congestion linked by seq and left undetermined

Codex review of 73445cb, documents only (report section 9, history #400, plan P2/P11).

- avgLatencyUs is FrameGate::aligned_lag_us averaged per second: first sample is zero,
  negatives clipped, evaluated after decode. The 113 ms / 8.4 ms medians are relative
  timeline lag, not absolute capture->display latency; the host-share attribution is
  dropped and decUs/d2pUs stay separate conditional samples (no "viewer total ~10 ms").
- nackSent=0 / fecRecovered=0 / reorder=0 means no retransmit or repair was observed, so
  the NACK effect is unproven; it is not a zero-loss claim. dropped=57 are AU
  discontinuities closed by keyResync, sender gap vs AU loss indistinguishable.
- UAC congestion x2 linked by seq+gen: the second (seq 24488) follows the DXGI-restore
  first frame seq 24484 (capture stamp ~820 ms older than its pre-enqueue send-ready
  time, viewer c2eUs 812 ms) being re-anchored after an 809 ms silence and then 24486-24488
  arriving 2-3 ms apart with fresh stamps; the first (seq 24471) is not the WGC first frame
  (seq 24456, presented normally) but seq 24469 (c2eUs 503 ms) after a silence 2.3 s later.
  The wall-clock inversion is a +556 ms clock offset seen on both request round trips.
  Host-side origin of the stale stamps and any relation to the synthetic-frame path stay
  undetermined; P11 is downgraded to "UAC-associated congestion x2, candidate cause".
